name: Nyet! Trio (Widow edition, compact)
summary: Three players veto trump and choose who goes Lone, then play 5 tricks per deal over 6 deals. The Lone takes the face-up Widow and scores 2 per trick won; the other two, the Pair, each score 1 per trick their side wins.

player.meaning: round number of this player's most recent trick win, 0 if none (second tie-break)
private hand of cards such as 'Red 3'
colour of the card played to the current trick
rank (1 to 6) of the card played to the current trick
scratch value: strength of the card this player played to the current trick, worked out from the face-up card, so it reveals nothing hidden

game.meaning: 1 is the veto round; 2 to 6 are trick rounds
undealt cards; after a deal it holds the 8 set-aside cards, which are never revealed
the face-up Widow card for this deal
this deal's trump line, in order
this deal's First, Second and Third seats
trump boxes holding a Nyet token
lone boxes (First, Second, Third) holding a Nyet token
seat that leads the current trick
colour of the leader's card in the current trick
seat that won the last trick

setup: Seats 1, 2 and 3 are P1, P2 and P3; clockwise order is 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1.
Every player's score, lone_tricks and last_win are set to 0.
The full card set is 24 unique cards: Red, Yellow, Green and Blue, each numbered 1 to 6.

round.effect: when round_in_deal == 1: empty every hand (cards are discarded unseen); deck = all 24 cards; draw 5 cards at random from deck into each player's hand; draw 1 card at random from deck into widow (the remaining 8 stay in deck, hidden, as the set-aside cards); clear trump_tokens and lone_tokens; set trump_order (deals 1 and 5: Red, Yellow, Green, Blue; deals 2 and 6: Yellow, Green, Blue, Red; deal 3: Green, Blue, Red, Yellow; deal 4: Blue, Red, Yellow, Green); set veto_order (deals 1 and 4: 1, 2, 3; deals 2 and 5: 2, 3, 1; deals 3 and 6: 3, 1, 2); clear trump, lone_seat and roles
when round_in_deal == 1: each player sees their own 5-card hand
when round_in_deal == 1: announce deal, widow, trump_order (the TRUMP line), the LONE line boxes First/Second/Third with their seats from veto_order, and that the board is empty
when round_in_deal == 1: all messages are collected at once and then broadcast {"to": "all", "text": "Seat {seat} says: {value}"}

round.answer: one empty box: a TRUMP colour not in trump_tokens, or a LONE box (First/Second/Third) if lone_tokens is empty; never the last empty box of a line
round.effect: when round_in_deal == 1: append the chosen colour to trump_tokens, or the chosen lone box to lone_tokens; announce the placement

round.answer: one empty box, under the same restrictions, seeing the tokens already placed
round.effect: when round_in_deal == 1: append to trump_tokens or lone_tokens; announce the placement

round.answer: one empty box, under the same restrictions, seeing the tokens already placed
round.effect: when round_in_deal == 1: append to trump_tokens or lone_tokens; announce the placement

when round_in_deal == 1: trump = first colour in trump_order not in trump_tokens; lone_seat = the veto_order seat at the first of the First, Second, Third positions not in lone_tokens; role = 'lone' for lone_seat and 'pair' for the other two; append widow to the Lone's hand (6 cards); leader = lone_seat
when round_in_deal == 1: announce trump, the Lone (lone_seat) and the Pair seats, and that the Lone leads the first trick
when round_in_deal == 1: each player sees their own hand (the Lone now sees 6 cards)
when round_in_deal >= 2: remove the card from hand; set played_colour and played_rank; led_colour = played_colour; announce the card

round.answer: one card from own hand of colour led_colour if holding any, otherwise any card in hand
round.effect: when round_in_deal >= 2: remove the card from hand; set played_colour and played_rank; announce the card

round.answer: one card from own hand of colour led_colour if holding any, otherwise any card in hand
round.effect: when round_in_deal >= 2: remove the card from hand; set played_colour and played_rank; announce the card

when round_in_deal >= 2: for each player, strength = (played_colour == trump) * 200 + (played_colour == led_colour) * 100 + played_rank; trick_winner = the seat with the highest strength; if trick_winner == lone_seat then that player's score += 2 and lone_tricks += 1, otherwise each player with role 'pair' gets score += 1; trick_winner's last_win = round; leader = trick_winner
when round_in_deal >= 2: announce the three cards played, trick_winner, and every score, lone_tricks and last_win
when round_in_deal >= 2: each player sees their own remaining hand
end the game if round >= 36, otherwise continue

ending.decided_by: The highest score wins. A tie goes to the tied player with the most lone_tricks, then to the one with the highest last_win (who won a trick most recently). Players still level share the win, which is the draw.

rules.text: When the game starts, then each of the 3 players has score 0, lone_tricks 0 and last_win 0.
When round is 1, 7, 13, 19, 25 or 31, then it is a veto round; every other round is a trick round.
When a veto round starts, then all hands are emptied, the 24-card deck is rebuilt, each player receives 5 private cards, 1 card becomes the public widow, and 8 cards remain hidden in deck.
When a veto round starts, then trump_tokens and lone_tokens are empty.
When deal is 1 or 4, then the veto order is seats 1, 2, 3; when deal is 2 or 5, it is 2, 3, 1; when deal is 3 or 6, it is 3, 1, 2.

When deal is 1 or 5, then trump_order is Red, Yellow, Green, Blue; when deal is 2 or 6, it is Yellow, Green, Blue, Red; when deal is 3, it is Green, Blue, Red, Yellow; when deal is 4, it is Blue, Red, Yellow, Green.
When the veto round talk happens, then all 3 players submit one short message at once, and all messages are shown to everyone only after all are in.
When a player places a Nyet token, then it goes on exactly one empty box, and the player sees all tokens already placed.
When lone_tokens already holds a token, then no further token may be placed on the LONE line this deal.
When a box is the last empty box of its line, then no token may be placed on it.
When all 3 tokens are placed, then trump is the first colour in trump_order without a token.
When all 3 tokens are placed, then the Lone is the seat of the first of First, Second, Third without a token, and the other two seats are the Pair.
When the Lone is chosen, then the widow is added to the Lone's hand, giving 6 cards, and the Lone leads the first trick.
When a trick is played, then the leader plays first, then the next seat clockwise, then the third seat, each seeing the cards already played.
When a player holds a card of led_colour, then they must play a card of led_colour; otherwise they may play any card in hand.
When any trump is played in a trick, then the highest trump wins; otherwise the highest card of led_colour wins.
When the Lone wins a trick, then the Lone's score rises by 2 and lone_tricks by 1.
When a Pair member wins a trick, then the score of each of the two Pair members rises by 1.
When a player wins a trick, then their last_win is set to the current round number and they lead the next trick of the deal.
When the 5th trick of a deal ends, then the Lone's 1 remaining card is never played or revealed and is discarded at the next shuffle.
When round 36 ends, then the game ends.
When the game ends, then the highest score wins; ties go to most lone_tricks, then highest last_win; players still tied share the win as a draw.

offers.question: Nyet token placement (First, Second, Third in turn)
offers.who: the seat at that position of veto_order
offers.options: if lone_tokens is empty: each TRUMP colour not in trump_tokens plus each LONE box (First, Second, Third) not in lone_tokens, excluding any box that is the last empty one of its line; if lone_tokens has a token: only the TRUMP colours not in trump_tokens, excluding the last empty one

offers.question: Lead a card
offers.options: every card in the leader's hand

offers.question: Follow to the trick
offers.who: the second and third seats clockwise from the leader
offers.options: if the seat holds a card of led_colour: only its cards of led_colour; otherwise every card in its hand

choices.why: The designer fixed 3 seats. The game is one Lone against a Pair of two, and both the veto order and the LONE line have exactly 3 positions, so no other count works. The strategy is to veto colours and Lone positions to steer trump toward your own hand, and to judge whether to go Lone or force someone else into it.

choices.what: Talk is kept as a simultaneous poll with broadcast
choices.why: The rules say all three write at once without seeing each other. The players disagree about trump and about who should be Lone, so talk gives them something to bluff and bargain over.

choices.what: Cards are text such as 'Red 3', handled through played_colour and played_rank
choices.why: This lets the trick winner be found by arithmetic: strength = trump bonus 200 + led bonus 100 + rank.

choices.what: strength is a public scratch attribute
choices.why: It is computed only from cards already played face up, so making it public reveals nothing; a player attribute may not be hidden from all.

choices.what: The 8 set-aside cards stay in the hidden deck list
choices.why: They are never revealed or used, so the hidden deck can hold them.

choices.what: Tie-break encoded as score*10000 + lone_tricks*100 + last_win
choices.why: lone_tricks is at most 30 and last_win at most 36, both under 100, so the order is strictly lexicographic. A full tie shares the win, which is the source's draw.

simplifications.what: Veto-round and trick-round steps are one flat list, each step gated by a 'when' condition on round_in_deal
simplifications.why: The engine has no branching blocks. Per-step conditions reproduce the alternation exactly.

simplifications.what: The 'Lone leads first' and 'winner leads next' rules are kept as a leader table attribute, and play order is addressed relative to the leader
simplifications.why: The engine addresses seats by attribute rather than by a fixed rotation.
